horizons.name: short
horizons.label: 1-2 weeks
horizons.hypothesis: Volume-supported directional continuation is plausible for individually flagged watchlist names; cross-market risk can override.
horizons.confirmation: Validate each logged signal against 1306.T or SPY after the 1w horizon; inspect price breadth and volatility jointly.
horizons.invalidation: A contrary relative return at the predetermined endpoint or worsening rates/credit stress.
horizons.trade_policy: Existing orders unchanged. New purchase only after liquidity, risk and human review.

horizons.name: medium
horizons.label: 1-3 months
horizons.hypothesis: Sector and positioning rotation may outlast an index bounce; corporate earnings and revised guidance must corroborate.
horizons.confirmation: Observe relative sector returns and dated positioning/credit data for 20-60 sessions.
horizons.invalidation: Rotation reverses for several weeks or earnings/credit assumptions change materially.
horizons.trade_policy: Review 1-in-1-out replacements, position concentration, and portfolio correlations; no model-driven orders.

horizons.name: long
horizons.label: 1-3 years
horizons.hypothesis: Long-run outcomes depend on earnings power, capital allocation, valuation and structural demand, not weekly order flow.
horizons.confirmation: Require multi-year primary fundamentals, valuation ranges, and thesis-specific catalysts.
horizons.invalidation: Thesis deterioration, adverse cash-flow revisions, or lasting competitive disadvantage.
horizons.trade_policy: Core accumulation and strategic holdings require separate cash-flow and thesis checks; no long-term directional forecast without evidence.

limits: Regime confidence describes source coverage, not prediction accuracy.
0.55 is a declared research prior, not a calibrated model probability.
Volume/price co-movement is not proof of institutional buying or distribution.
Delayed position/short interest releases must be evaluated by their as-of date, never publication day alone.
This module does not place orders, alter ranking, or override existing risk and data-quality gates.
